tools.name: get_page

This is the one authenticated tool: it needs an OAuth Bearer token in the Authorization header of the HTTP request carrying this call. Registration is open and instant (POST https://mcp.strata

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_growth_audit" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Submit a request for the free 30-minute growth consultation on behalf of a specific human who asked for it. This is the one authenticated tool: it needs an OAut…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, list_case_studies, get_page, request_growth_audit · Private data: request_growth_audit · Public sink: request_growth_audit · Destructive: list_free_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, list_case_studies, get_page, request_growth_audit · Private data: request_growth_audit · Public sink: request_growth_audit · Destructive: list_free_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
